subject: Fix keepEdge verdict to clear needs_rejudge flag for already-judged (legacy) edges
description: BUG found during the #22 legacy re-judge run (blocks it). In routes/judge.js the /judge/verdict keepEdge path only acts when the edge has judged===false. But legacy edges marked via /judge/rejudge-edges are judged===true, so a KEEP verdict on them is a silent no-op: the overlay.edgeRejudge[sig] flag is never cleared, the edge stays needs_rejudge, and /judge/next re-serves it forever (infinite loop). Only pruneEdge clears the flag (as a side effect of removing the edge). FIX: on a KEEP verdict, if the edge carries a needs_rejudge / edgeRejudge flag, clear that flag (overlay.clearEdgeRejudge) and journal the keep verdict, regardless of judged state — leaving the kept edge intact (weight/judged unchanged) but removing it from the rejudge queue. Add a regression test: a judged===true edge flagged needs_rejudge, given a keep verdict, → flag cleared, edge no longer surfaced by /judge/next, edge still present; prune path still works. Surgical/additive. Files: routes/judge.js (verdict handler), lib/overlay.js (clearEdgeRejudge), lib/judge.js (buildQueue surfacing). Reference: Judge G commit 0e509f0 + #30 endpoint.

summary: Fixed the legacy re-judge no-op bug. ROOT CAUSE: in routes/judge.js POST /judge/verdict keepEdge block, the if was gated solely on judge.keepEdge() returning truthy — but keepEdge() only promotes/returns true for a weight-0 (judged===false) autowire edge. A LEGACY edge (judged===true, weight>0) flagged needs_rejudge returned falsy, so the whole block (incl. clearEdgeRejudge) was skipped → flag persisted → /judge/next re-served it forever. KEEP verdicts on legacy edges were silent no-ops. FIX (9-line, additive): compute wasRejudgeFlagged from T.ov.edgeRejudge[from>>to] BEFORE calling keepEdge; enter the block when promoted OR (wasRejudgeFlagged && kept). Clears flag + journals keep WITHOUT re-promoting weight for already-judged edges. Weight-0 promotion path identical. TEST: new test/judge-keep-legacy-rejudge.test.js drives the REAL route handler (makeRoute mock ctx, no port) — asserts flag cleared, edge no longer surfaced by /judge/next, edge still judged===true with weight unchanged (0.7, no double-promote), keep journaled (10/10 PASS). REGRESSION: judge-rejudge-edges 13/13, judging-gate 22/22, judge-verdict 32/32, autowire-weight0-promotion 13/13 — all green. Committed b25989d on branch orch/attempt/091a4bf1-...-31. RESTART NEEDED = YES (running daemon holds stale routes/judge.js in memory).
